title: acer campbellii subsp. sinense
intro: Acer campbellii subsp. sinense, commonly known as the Chinese paperbark maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the mountainous regions of southwestern China. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving circulation. The therapeutic actions of Acer campbellii subsp. sinense are attributed to its ability to promote diuresis, reduce fever, and alleviate pain, making it a valuable remedy for treating conditions such as urinary tract infections and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
